items: ¼ lb vermicelli (skinny spaghetti), broken into 1-inch pieces
¼ cup chopped nuts (we like roasted almonds best)

steps.title: Brown the pasta
steps.body: In pot with a lid, sauté until lightly brown: **2 Tbsp butter** and **¼ lb vermicelli** (skinny spaghetti), broken into 1-inch pieces.

steps.title: Add the nuts and rice
steps.body: Add and coat with butter: **¼ cup chopped nuts** (we like roasted almonds best) and **2 cups rice**.

steps.title: Add the liquid
steps.body: Add **4 cups water**, **4 tsp chicken stock base**, **½ tsp salt** and **½ tsp black pepper**.

steps.title: Simmer and check
steps.body: Cover and simmer (on low). After about 20 minutes, check for doneness. Season with additional salt and pepper to taste.
